# My plan for this year

Aiyo, I'm 68 now, these old bones don't move like they used to. Just me and the old man at home, both of us old. So I can't take on too much fussy work. I've been farming this land for 50 years, I know what works.

I have 15.5 mu total. Let me think about each piece:

**Cotton (棉花) — about 5 mu.** I always grow cotton. Grew it when I was young, grow it now. The western villages here all grow cotton. I save some seed but I'll buy a new bag too from the agri-store in town, the boss there knows me. I put down two bags of compound fertilizer (那个15-15-15的) before planting, and one bag of urea (尿素) when the plants are about knee-high. For every few mu I mean, not per mu — a bag of compound maybe spreads over 3 mu. The bollworms (棉铃虫) are terrible, I have to spray three, four times, can't skip. My daughter-in-law comes to help with picking in autumn, otherwise I can't finish.

**Maize (玉米) — about 5 mu.** Easy crop, that's why I grow it at my age. I buy hybrid seed from the store, the one neighbor Old Wang also uses, he says it does well. One bag of compound fertilizer at planting, urea when it gets tall. I water once, maybe twice if no rain comes. My son comes back from the city to help with harvest, we use the neighbor's machine and I pay him a little.

**Chinese cabbage (大白菜) — about 3 mu.** I plant after the summer heat breaks, around August time, harvest before the hard frost. This is my cash crop, the traders come from town to buy. I put a lot of fertilizer — this crop is greedy, needs feeding. Also some chicken manure if my nephew gives me some. Water often, especially when the heads are filling.

**Cabbage (甘蓝) — about 1.5 mu.** Spring cabbage, I buy the seedlings (I don't raise my own anymore, too much fuss). Plant early spring, sell in early summer when prices are decent. Less area because the market isn't always good.

**Chili (辣椒) — about 1 mu.** Just a small piece. The wife-er, I mean I — pick them myself every few days all summer. Good money if the price holds but very tiring at my age. Can't do more than 1 mu.

I can't afford to apply fertilizer like the young business farmers with machines. Every yuan I spend I think twice. If I have a bad year I have no cushion. Better to put a bit less fertilizer and save some money in the jar. My pension and what my son sends cover the house, the land has to pay for itself.
